name: What should I do first when planning a rental property restoration project?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first when planning a rental property restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first step in planning a rental property restoration project is a thorough assessment of the property's current condition and a clear definition of your goals. Determine what needs repair, replacement, or upgrade. Establish a budget and research potential contractors. Getting multiple bids and ensuring the contractor understands your vision and timeline are crucial initial steps before any work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, assess the property's condition, define your goals, set a budget, and research qualified general contractors for bids.
